title: SN 1987A: registered Hubble–Webb structure comparison
question: Which normalized structures remain spatially similar between HST F625W in 2018 and JWST F200W in 2022?
results: normalized remnant intensity correlation 0.921 at 0.12 arcsec common FWHM
edge-map correlation 0.832 at the same smoothing
correlations explicitly tested from 0.10 to 0.18 arcsec
validation: The calibrated cutouts are registered by celestial WCS, normalized separately, blurred to four common resolutions, and compared in intensity and edge space.
provenance: HST program 15256 F625W HAP DRC product, 2018-07-08
both compact cutouts preserve WCS and original product names
limitations: filters trace different wavelengths and emission processes
approximate Gaussian PSFs do not reproduce full instrument PSF wings
correlation is descriptive, not a physical model
